info.name: Microsoft Power Apps Microsoft Dataverse Web Accounts Entities API
Microsoft Power Apps Retrieve Entity Definitions

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of property names to include in the response. Use to limit the properties returned and improve performance.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict the set of records returned. Supports standard OData comparison, logical, and function operators.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to sort results by, each optionally followed by asc or desc.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

params.name: $count
params.description: Set to true to include a count of matching records in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a collection of entity (table) definitions from Dataverse. This endpoint provides metadata about the tables available in the environment, including their logical names, collection names, and structural information. This is a read-only endpoint supporting only RetrieveMultiple operations.

info.name: Microsoft Power Apps Retrieve a Single Entity Definition

params.name: entityid
params.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the entity definition.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of property names to include in the response. Use to limit the properties returned and improve performance.

items.docs: Retrieves a single entity (table) definition by its unique identifier. Provides metadata about the table including its logical name, collection name, and structural information.
